title: Pagination edges — small page size, last-page short row
description: Stress-tests pagination: a tiny `pageSize` so several pages exist, plus a final page that is intentionally shorter than `pageSize` to verify the last-page indicator + Next-button-disabled state.

data.markdown: When `pageSize: N`, the DataTable splits its rows into chunks of N. The widget renders a page-of-N indicator and Prev/Next controls; Prev is disabled on page 0, Next is disabled on the last page. Filters that shrink the result set should clamp the active page DURING render (no `useEffect`+`setState` to avoid the `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` lint rule).
